activation_required: Verify the caller repository uses this reviewed contract and passes its delivery tests.
Provision the dedicated key through the approved secret-management path on both sides.
Verify an authenticated delivery, replay, and CRM readback before processing the backlog.
Keep this manifest byte-identical in WARP and Marketing; verify the guarded append and read-only check against the merged receiver before activation.

rules: One source inquiry creates exactly one customer activity while that activity is retained, including on retry; source UUID spelling is case-insensitive.
Explicit deletion of the receipt activity or its customer ends replay protection and a later delivery can recreate records.
Without rejectExistingCustomer, an exact unique normalized primary-phone match receives a new activity; do not overwrite its customer profile.
Multiple normalized primary-phone matches return 409 ambiguous_phone and create no record, with or without the guard.
Unknown names remain blank; source status remains in activity content.
Read and append only within the two exact source_scope and landing_source_scope tuples. No arbitrary customer updates or deletion.
Interpret original date and minute as Asia/Seoul for CRM date fields and preserve the original strings in activity content.

For receiver validation, append matching and read-only checks, normalize valid Korean mobiles with normalizeCustomerMobile first; otherwise accept digitsOnly values of 9 to 15 digits, preserving fixed-line and other legacy contacts. Invalid or missing contacts never match; company phones and secondary contacts do not match. Archived CustomerMerge aliases are not separate customers.

When rejectExistingCustomer is true, resolve a retained deterministic receipt first; otherwise a single matching primary phone returns 409 phone_exists before any Customer or CustomerActivity mutation.
Receipt lookup, phone matching and append run inside the shared customerWrite transaction, serialized with customer merges.

created is true only when this request creates a Customer; duplicate is true only when replaying a retained source inquiry activity. A new activity on an existing Customer returns created:false and duplicate:false.
Resolve receipt customer aliases to the current canonical Customer, preserving the deterministic activityId; missing or invalid canonical receipts fail closed.
Checks use a read-only transaction snapshot, expose only sourceId and existence unless that exact scoped sourceId has a retained deterministic activity, and never return customer names or contacts.
Check receipts contain ok:true, customerId, activityId, created:false, duplicate:true and are not evidence of fresh Customer creation; Marketing preserves historical WARP_RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED markers.
Landing append requires its bounded landing object and rejectExistingCustomer:true; the collected source never accepts landing metadata.
Keep legacy mleverage_ deterministic activity IDs byte-compatible. Check and replay must use the true source tuple, including when both sources have the same sourceId.

Landing customer source, original seconds, consultation kind, region and consent version/time are preserved in Customer/CustomerActivity; the receipt response shape and dedicated key remain unchanged.
Marketing holds every unsent same-phone inquiry across both supported sources for review. Previously delivered or explicitly confirmed evidence is retained.
A landing retry after error or interruption requires a fresh manual registration request. Recovered receipts remain registration-unverified unless fresh Customer creation was confirmed.

Marketing serializes landing dispatch claim and closure using its SQLite writer lock. Closure cancels unsent queued work, rejects in-flight work, and deletes only local landing PII. WARP records require a separate WARP process.

items.phone: string, at most 40 characters; valid Korean mobiles normalize first (including +82/0082 and legacy 011/016/017/018/019), otherwise 9 to 15 digits after digitsOnly normalization

results.receipt: present only for the caller's deterministic retained inquiry activity

required_landing_fields.region: null for consultation; 서울 | 경기 | 인천 for subsidy
required_landing_fields.consentVersion: 1-80 ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen
required_landing_fields.consentedAt: canonical ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds

landing_request.dispatch: Only an explicit per-inquiry manual registration request; never automatic backlog, pilot, or legacy recovery selection
rollout: Deploy the reviewed WARP receiver before the Marketing caller.
Keep existing automatic delivery settings unchanged; do not send historical or live inquiries for release validation.
